### A Well of Water
Author: Jill Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-women/a-well-of-water-one-year-devotions-for-women-january-9.html
Passage: Genesis 21:17
Points:
- Hagar gave up all hope when their meager water ran out in the desert heat.
- Uncontrolled grief and distress can blind us to the help directly in front of us.
- God listened to the cry of the boy right where he was lying.
- Ceasing our frantic cries allows us to listen expectantly for God's voice.
- God always makes living water available to guide and sustain us in crises.

### When God Shows Up, Don't Forget It
Author: Sharon Jaynes
Site: Girlfriends in God
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/when-god-shows-up-don-t-forget-it-girlfriends-in-god-july-21-2014.html
Passage: Genesis 21:19
Points:
- After being banished into the wilderness, Hagar succumbed to despair and abandoned hope.
- The well of water was present the entire time, but Hagar needed God to open her eyes.
- We often forget past encounters with El Roi, the God who sees, when new hardships arise.
- God gently invites us to remember His past faithfulness and look for His current provision.
- After receiving God's refreshing help, we are meant to fill our vessel and nourish others.

### God Rescues Ishmael
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/god-rescues-ishmael
Passage: Genesis 21:20-21
Points:
- Hagar faced a desperate wilderness situation with inadequate supplies for her son.
- God intervened mercifully because He has a special care for those who are afflicted.
- While God directed Abraham to preserve Isaac's inheritance, He did not share Sarah's harsh attitude.
- Ishmael received God's providential protection and sustenance even outside the covenant line.
- Christians can rely on God's sustaining grace when outward circumstances look entirely lost.

### Praying the Names of God - June 25
Author: Ann Spangler
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/prayingnamesgod/praying-the-names-of-god-july-7-11578918.html
Passage: Genesis 21:17-19
Points:
- Paralyzed by helplessness in the heat, Hagar wept at a distance from her dying child.
- God called to her in her agony and showed that Ishmael's name ("God hears") remained true.
- The Lord opened Hagar's eyes to see a lifesaving well of water.
- Divine promises may stretch thin during severe trials, but they never break.
- Believers can cry out to El Roi, confident that He observes and answers their deepest anguish.
